name: QuPath
description: Native QuPath for digital pathology and whole-slide image analysis.
notes: Independent App package using the Desktop native-stream host. Native process ownership and Groovy bridge live in this package; the node supplies QuPath and Xpra.

actions.name: status
actions.description: Read this QuPath session and its current GUI image, project, viewer and object summary.

actions.name: close
actions.description: Request normal close; preserve QuPath Save/Cancel dialogs.

actions.name: run_script
actions.description: Run Groovy against this open QuPath GUI, including unsaved image state. Returns a request id; use script_status after a wait timeout.

params.request_id: optional unique string, retained for idempotency within this GUI session
params.wait_s: 0–10 seconds (default 2); a timeout does not cancel execution
params.expected_image: optional image_token from desktop_read/status; null requires no image to be open
params.update_hierarchy: optional boolean (default true); use false for read-only, export and save scripts to skip automatic hierarchy notification; never clears existing unsaved changes

actions.name: script_status
actions.description: Read the result of an existing script request without executing it again.
